card.name: Mountaineering and neck surgery passages
card.fires_on: Ordinary linking words and verbs inside two specific passages: descriptions of Himalayan peaks like Everest and Lhotse, and a description of neck surgery for hyperparathyroidism.

modes.label: Himalayan peak descriptions
modes.description: Small words like in, the, most or summit in text about Everest, Lhotse and other mountains.
modes.example: The ascent to this peak is described as a classic climb<< in>> the 7000m peak

modes.label: Neck surgery for parathyroid disease
modes.description: Words such as be, performed, challenging or a comma in a sentence saying the neck operation is technically challenging.
modes.example: the surgery can<< be>> technically challenging and usually is performed in conjunction
